coverage_verdict: Data preparation/confirmation and all nine declared study themes are covered; main text is selective, complete adopted output families are indexed. No claim to plot every stored row or reproduce every derivation in the PDF.
findings_resolved: Earlier historical themes had weak graphical coverage: added one descriptive three-panel figure from adopted outputs

Paired strength-adjusted comparison was described only in prose: added equivalent fixed-reference expectation equation
Heading-first paragraphs followed the class default: chose uniform 1.5em body indentation using indentfirst
Float placement and forced bibliography break produced large interior white space: adjusted float policy and let references follow text
Tight bibliography continuation could leave an almost empty last page: used a consistent 10pt font/11pt leading and 1pt item spacing
Protected numeric pp units and page breaks at hyphenated words; improved sample-table width
Clarified four separately calibrated historical families and error parameter 0.01; no joint all-198 guarantee
